messages.content: You answer a question about a short text from what you know. Pick one of the allowed answers. Give the probability, from 0 to 1, that your answer is right.

Each unit is the title of a song by the Beatles. Which one was first released on the album Yellow Submarine?

Units:
- Hey Bulldog
- A Taste of Honey
- Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band
- The Long and Winding Road
- Don't Bother Me
- You Won't See Me
- Maxwell's Silver Hammer
- Any Time at All
